visual.general_description: Two side-by-side contrast-enhanced-looking CT images of the upper abdomen showing a very large rounded low-attenuation cyst.
visual.detailed_description: Two unlabelled cross-sectional CT images are placed side by side with a thin dark border. Each shows a very large, rounded, uniformly darker (fluid-like) cystic structure with a thin well-defined wall in the left upper abdomen region of the image, displacing adjacent organs. The left image is a lengthwise (sagittal-type) reformat showing the cyst above a bright kidney with bowel loops and ribs along the margins, and part of the heart/diaphragm region at the top. The right image is a coronal-type reformat showing the same large cyst on the right side of the image beside a liver, a bright kidney and spine and ribs. No internal septa or daughter-cyst structures are evident at this image resolution. No panel letters, arrows, measurement calipers, scale or text are visible. A thin green line with a small yellow tick runs along the bottom edge of the right image; it looks like a viewer overlay and carries no text.
